name: Rafael Souza
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate machinery of go-karts as a child in São Paulo. He honed his skills through years of working on local racing teams, quickly developing a reputation for meticulousness and problem-solving. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering and eventually landed a role in Formula racing.

Now a key member of the Stake Sauber fabricator team, Rafael is known for his pragmatic approach and ability to identify the most efficient solutions under pressure. He thrives on the challenge of translating engineering designs into tangible components, ensuring every piece meets the team's exacting standards. His loyalty and commitment to quality make him a valued asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a stocky build, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and measurements.
Has a specific set of tools he insists on using for every job.
Listens to Brazilian jazz music through headphones while working.
